scope: Published decisions dated 2016-01-01 through 2025-12-31; Ottawa s.53 HTA pilot
method: Opened each of the 133 source pages in the public CanLII browser interface.
Screened text for the charge/proceeding, s.53 references, suspended-driving wording and outcome; checked surrounding passages. This is a relevance/outcome review, not a full legal case analysis.

Retrieved uncropped text in chunks for long decisions. Two clearly unrelated proceedings (IDs 126 and 132) were excluded by their opening and proceeding scope after repeated long-page navigation/evaluation failures. Their cached body extracts are truncated; this is explicit in review_method.

Classifications and source locators are reviewer-authored. Search matches are not counted as charges; historical/cited outcomes and criminal prohibited-driving convictions are not recoded as s.53 trial verdicts.
limitations: This completes only the retained 133-candidate list, not all published judgments or all Ottawa s.53 cases.
CanLII is not exhaustive; other search terms and unindexed or unpublished documents may yield additional cases.
Decision date differs from trial/disposition date. Multiple judgments may concern one case, and a judgment may address multiple charges.
No candidate was linked to the annual OCJ charge totals and no trial totals were reclassified.

A null trial outcome means not established in this document, not acquitted or no trial. Geography concerns the relationship identified in the text; an Ottawa hearing, residence or cited policy alone is insufficient.
